subject: maths
question: In an election between two candidates, 80% of the registered voters cast their vote and 21% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 51% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1817 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Registered Voters = Margin ÷ (Polled% × Valid% × Margin% of Valid)

Margin% = 51% − (100% − 51%) = 2%

Valid% = 100% − 21% = 79%

Total Voters = 1817 ÷ (80% × 79% × 2%)

Total Voters = 1817 ÷ 0.01264 = 143750

**∴ The correct answer is 143750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Registered voters who cast votes = 80%

Invalid votes = 21%

Winning candidate's share = 51% of valid votes

Winning margin = 1817 votes

 
 
 

 
 

 
 Registered Voters
 
 
• 
 80% Polled

 
 Polled Votes

 
• 
 79% Valid

 
 Valid Votes

 
• 
 2% Margin

 
 Margin = 1817 Votes

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total registered voters be 100 units.

⇒ Votes polled = 80% of 100 = 80 units

⇒ Valid votes = (100 − 21)% of 80 units = 79% of 80 = 63.2 units

⇒ Winner's votes = 51% of 63.2 units

⇒ Loser's votes = (100 − 51)% = 49% of 63.2 units

⇒ Winning margin = (51 − 49)% of 63.2 units = 2% of 63.2 units

⇒ Margin = 0.02 × 63.2 = 1.264 units

⇒ 1.264 units = 1817

⇒ 1 unit = 1817 ÷ 1.264 = 1437.5

⇒ Total registered voters (100 units) = 1437.5 × 100 = 143750

**∴ The correct answer is 143750 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Election Percentage Concept

In election-based problems, always clearly distinguish between "Total Registered Voters", "Polled Votes", and "Valid Votes". Calculations are typically a chain of percentages applied consecutively on the reduced base.

Winning Margin Rule

The margin of victory is the difference in percentage between the winner and the loser. If a winner gets x% of valid votes, the loser gets (100 − x)%, and the direct margin equals (2x − 100)% of the valid votes.

Successive Percentage Trick

When multiple fractional drops are applied one after another, the final value can be directly found using continuous multiplying factors: Final = Initial × (a ÷ 100) × (b ÷ 100) × (c ÷ 100).
